clips.title: The story
paras: In the Stormwind Stockade, Bazil Thredd leads the Defias inmates in revolt from the eastern cell block. Edwin VanCleef's lieutenant has been imprisoned there since the Stonemasons' riots.

Bazil Thredd stood beside Edwin VanCleef when the Stonemasons Guild rose against Stormwind's nobility. The guild had been refused payment for rebuilding the city, and VanCleef rejected the government's appeasements and sparked open revolt. Thredd served as his chief lieutenant and most trusted assistant. The city guard captured Thredd during the violent clashes that followed. VanCleef and the surviving masons fled into Westfall and formed the Defias Brotherhood, while Thredd was sent into the Stormwind Stockade.

A prison riot has overrun the guards, opened the cells, and turned the Stockade into an armed fortress beneath the Mage Quarter. Thredd commands the imprisoned Defias bandits, insurgents, and allied cutthroats from a post in the eastern wing, guarded by an ogre named Hamhock. For years, he had stayed silent behind bars, seemingly forsaken. Now Warden Thelwater wants Thredd's head, hoping to break the rebellion's leadership before the chaos reaches the city streets.
